autoRotateDependency.description: Install iio-sensor-proxy so monitor-sensor and the sensor service are available for tablet-mode rotation.
autoRotateDependency.label: Auto-rotate requires iio-sensor-proxy

autoRotateInTabletMode.description: Use monitor-sensor while tablet mode is active to rotate the internal display automatically.
autoRotateInTabletMode.label: Auto-rotate screen in tablet mode

autoRotateOutsideTabletMode.description: Keep sensor-based auto-rotation available even when tablet mode is not active.
autoRotateOutsideTabletMode.label: Allow auto-rotate outside tablet mode

autoTabletBarDensity.description: When tablet mode is active, switch Noctalia's bar density automatically.
autoTabletBarDensity.label: Auto-switch bar density in tablet mode

buttonBehavior.description: Choose whether the main button toggles auto-rotate lock or rotates the display manually.
buttonBehavior.label: Bar and Control Center button behavior

exclusiveDockInTabletMode.description: When tablet mode is active, enable the Noctalia dock if needed and switch it to exclusive mode.
exclusiveDockInTabletMode.label: Use exclusive dock in tablet mode

flipVerticalSensorOrientation.description: Swap left-up and right-up auto-rotate behavior for laptops whose sensor reports the portrait directions inverted.
flipVerticalSensorOrientation.label: Flip vertical sensor orientation

iconName.description: Tabler icon name used for the bar widget.
iconName.label: Bar icon

showSuccessToast.description: Display a toast after a rotation command succeeds.
showSuccessToast.label: Show success toast

showTransformInTooltip.description: Include the current rotation state in the bar widget tooltip.
showTransformInTooltip.label: Show transform in tooltip

syncHyprTouchTransform.description: After rotating a display on Hyprland, also rotate mapped touchscreen coordinates for matching touch devices.
syncHyprTouchTransform.label: Hyprland: sync touchscreen transform

tabletBarDensity.description: Choose the Noctalia bar density to apply while tablet mode is active.
tabletBarDensity.label: Tablet mode bar density
